d: A large, anthropomorphic rhino-like creature with a mature, stoic expression, featuring a single white horn on its nose and a gold ring piercing the nostrils. It has a heavy, muscular build with pale lavender-grey skin and a thick mane of fluffy, white fur extending from the neck and shoulders. The creature wears a deep red tunic with gold trim and a matching gold-buckled belt, paired with brown and gold armored pauldrons. It carries a massive, rectangular brown slab of carved stone or wood detailed with red tribal patterns and gold accents. BODY COLOR: pale lavender-grey LEGS: plantigrade with thick, rounded toes
